scenes.title: Hook
scenes.vo: Timberthane faux wood beams, from Ekena Millwork, are made to order: your shape, your texture, your finish, and your size.

scenes.title: Shapes
scenes.vo: Start with the shape. | A one-sided plank. | A two-sided L-beam. | A three-sided U-beam. | Or a four-sided box beam.

scenes.title: Textures
scenes.vo: Then the texture. | Hand Hewn. | Rough Sawn. | Rough Cedar. | Sandblasted. | Pecky Cypress. | Riverwood. | Knotty Pine. | And Rustic Smooth.

scenes.title: Finishes
scenes.vo: Then the finish. There are twenty-eight hand-finished colors, from light Sand Dune and Driftwood to deep Hickory and Cherry. Or Factory Prepped, ready for paint.

scenes.title: Width and height
scenes.card: 3 to 24 in, to the half inch
scenes.vo: Size it to the half inch: anywhere from three to twenty-four inches wide, and three to twenty-four inches tall.

scenes.title: Length
scenes.vo: Lengths run from two feet to thirty feet, to the inch.

scenes.title: Endcaps and lead time
scenes.card: Made to order in the USA
scenes.vo: Add one or two endcaps if you need them. Every beam is hand finished, made in the U.S.A., and usually ships in ten to twelve business days.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.vo: See the finish in person. Order a sample.
